text:
maya: hey team — need to swap my Sat night oncall (10pm-6am PT) due to a family thing. I'm on the blue rotation. Is anyone able to take it? I can cover a weekday instead. :pray:
aj: i can take the shift if no one else. quick Q: is the model roll scheduled for Sat morning or Sunday?
maya: thanks! it's actually a small canary on Sunday 2am PT on redwood/model-v2 — should be fine but watch latency; console will show canary flag. i'll add handoff notes shortly.
leon: i can do Sat night but covering + sunday morning? aj, if you take just night that's great. also FYI we're out of extra burst GPUs this weekend per infra slack.
maya: aj — it's just the night slot that needs cover. if you take it i'll DM you the KV cache warmup step. leon — thanks for offering but prefer single person.
aj: okay i'll take it. maya pls add notes and runbook links. :thumbsup:
maya: hand-off notes:
• no active incidents
• watch model-v2 canary on sunday 02:00 PT (endpoint /v1/generate)
• kv cache warmup: run `curl -X POST https://console/redwood/cache/warm -d '{"prefix":"/v1/generate"}'`
• if latency > 1s p50 or errors > 1% escalate to eng-oncall and page infra oncall
• creds: use Oncall key in 1Password (Oncall/Saturday)
link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-canary
ping if any questions
oncall-bot: Reminder: shift transfer recorded — aj is now owner for 2026-03-21 22:00-2026-03-22 06:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
sam: thanks aj — i'll be online early sunday for the canary 1:30-3:30 PT if you want backup during rollout.
aj: appreciate it sam. maya, i'll DM for creds. everyone, i'll post a brief update when i start.
